~Synopsis~
On New Year's Eve 2024, Kaori, who was working part-time as a shrine maiden at a nearby shrine, was suddenly called by the priest again and was about to be entrusted with a very important task.

------------- "Zeccho Kagura" -------------

The god "Pleasure God" enshrined here at Ikigurui Shrine is the god of sexual desire.
Every year on New Year's Eve, the shrine offers a dance called Zeccho Kagura.

Last year, she accepted a request to perform Zeccho Kagura in order to make money, but as a result, she experienced the hell of being made to climax 108 times.
And then, to her surprise, the priest asked her to perform Zeccho Kagura again this year. Kaori
refused the request, saying she had no desire to endure such hardship...

but will she be able to make it to 2025 safely this year?
